Je bent regelmatig op locatie en zorgt ervoor dat de volledige IT-omgeving van klanten correct geïnstalleerd, onderhouden en ondersteund wordt. Jouw rol Als Field Support Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de IT-omgeving van verschillende vestigingen binnen jouw regio. Je staat onder andere in voor: Volledige installatie en oplevering van IT-omgevingen op nieuwe of bestaande locaties Installatie en configuratie van servers, netwerken, firewalls, wifi, werkstations en randapparatuur Configuratie en beheer van SonicWall firewalls Installatie en ondersteuning van HP/HPE hardware Installatie, configuratie en troubleshooting van Windows Server en Windows 11 Installatie en ondersteuning van netwerkcomponenten zoals switches en access points Onderhoud en technische ondersteuning van bestaande klantomgevingen Troubleshooting van hardware-, netwerk- en infrastructuurproblemen Technische ondersteuning op bedrijfsspecifieke software Begeleiden en trainen van eindgebruikers in het gebruik van de software en IT-omgeving Opvolgen van technische interventies van probleem tot oplossing Je werkt dus niet uitsluitend vanuit een servicedesk. Je bent zelf actief op locatie , installeert omgevingen van A tot Z en blijft nadien het technische aanspreekpunt voor jouw klanten. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken vooral iemand die graag praktisch met IT bezig is en zelfstandig technische problemen kan aanpakken. Je hebt: Ervaring binnen een functie als Field Engineer, Support Engineer, System Engineer, IT Support Engineer of gelijkaardig Goede kennis van Windows 11 Ervaring met Windows Server Ervaring met hardware-installaties en troubleshooting Kennis van networking: switches, wifi, TCP/IP en algemene netwerkconfiguratie Ervaring met firewalls; kennis van SonicWall is een sterke troef Ervaring met HP/HPE hardware is mooi meegenomen Het vermogen om zelfstandig een kleine IT-omgeving te installeren en operationeel op te leveren Een praktische en klantgerichte ingesteldheid Je hoeft geen pure netwerk- of serverarchitect te zijn. We zoeken eerder een sterke allround infrastructuur- en supportengineer die graag zelf configureert, installeert en problemen oplost. Talen Nederlands: professioneel vereist Engels: professioneel vereist Frans: sterke troef Regio Je werkt voornamelijk bij klanten in Limburg . Omdat je verschillende locaties ondersteunt, hoort verplaatsing naar klanten bij de functie. Wat maakt deze functie interessant? Je krijgt veel autonomie en afwisseling: de ene dag bouw je een volledige IT-omgeving op, de volgende dag los je een netwerk- of serverprobleem op bij een bestaande klant. Je werkt bovendien met de volledige lokale infrastructuur — van firewall en netwerk tot server, werkstations en bedrijfsspecifieke applicaties — waardoor je technisch veel breder bezig bent dan in een klassieke supportfunctie. About The Role McKesson is seeking a Sr. Executive Support Engineer (Las Colinas) to deliver exceptional onsite and remote technical support across a modern enterprise technology environment. This role supports Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, Microsoft 365 services, endpoint management platforms, hardware troubleshooting, and user access administration while driving operational excellence across multiple locations. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, executive-level customer service, an AI-forward mindset, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they disrupt the employee experience. The engineer will use data, automation, AI-enabled tools, monitoring, and recurring-issue analysis to anticipate needs, reduce friction, and continuously improve service delivery. What You'll Do Provide advanced support for Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, and Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and Office apps. Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware and software issues involving Windows PCs, Macs, iPhones, iPads, printers, docking stations, mobile devices, and peripherals. Deliver high-touch, discreet, and responsive support for executives and their assistants in onsite, remote, and hybrid settings. Use monitoring, analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and trend analysis to identify risks and remediate issues before they affect users. Apply an AI mindset by evaluating practical use cases, improving workflows, documenting responsible usage, and helping users adopt AI capabilities effectively and securely. Manage incidents, requests, and problem records in ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform while meeting established service levels and maintaining clear stakeholder communication. Administer user accounts, permissions, and group memberships within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Support device deployment, software distribution, patching, configuration, and compliance through Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Apple management platforms, and related endpoint tools. Lead hardware refreshes, workstation deployments, technology upgrades, executive onboarding, and site support initiatives. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, networking, mobility, Apple, Microsoft, and vendor teams to resolve escalations and improve service delivery. Support executive meeting, video collaboration, and A/V needs, including visual team meetings, town halls, conference rooms, presentation readiness, and coordination with internal or vendor support teams. Create technical documentation, knowledge articles, end-user guidance, and training materials that make complex technology easy to understand. Mentor support engineers, share expertise, and convert repeat issues into scalable preventative solutions. Basic Requirements 7+ years of experience in IT Support, Desktop Support, Endpoint Support, Field Support, Executive Support, or a related technical support function. Enterprise experience supporting Windows 10/11, macOS, and iOS devices, including configuration, troubleshooting, updates, security controls, and interoperability. Experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 applications and services. Hands-on experience troubleshooting laptops, desktops, Macs, iPhones, iPads, printers, docking stations, and peripheral devices. Experience with ServiceNow or a similar IT Service Management platform. Experience managing users, groups, permissions, and access in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. Experience supporting endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and SCCM; familiarity with Apple device management and enrollment workflows. Demonstrated ability to anticipate user needs, identify recurring patterns, and implement proactive or preventative support actions. Practical understanding of enterprise AI capabilities, responsible AI principles, data protection, and ways AI can improve support productivity and user experience. Strong problem-solving, executive presence, customer service, discretion, documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Skills/Experience Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience supporting executives, executive assistants, or other high-touch user populations. Experience supporting geographically distributed and multi-site enterprise environments. Knowledge of endpoint security, compliance, conditional access, mobile device management, and device lifecycle management across Windows and Apple ecosystems. Experience with Apple Business Manager, Jamf, Microsoft Intune for Apple devices, enterprise iOS enrollment, or comparable Apple management tooling. Experience with software deployment, operating system imaging, automated provisioning, and zero-touch deployment. Experience using AI assistants, automation, scripting, knowledge management, or predictive experience tools to improve support outcomes. Familiarity with PowerShell, shell scripting, workflow automation, and API-based integrations. Experience coordinating enterprise technology rollouts and hardware refresh projects. Familiarity with executive A/V support, video conferencing, visual team meetings, town halls, room technology, presenter readiness, and live-event coordination. Experience mentoring junior engineers or serving as a technical escalation point. Knowledge of regulated environments such as healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly controlled industries. Travel, Work Location & Physical Requirements Ability to provide onsite support for assigned locations and occasional travel for projects, deployments, executive needs, site activities, meetings, town halls, or other executive technology events.
